mapper.select: SELECT connection_id, user_id, provider_id, external_connection_key, connection_status, connected_at, last_synced_at, disconnected_at, created_at, updated_at FROM account_connections WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND provider_id = #{providerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_connections (user_id, provider_id, external_connection_key, connection_status, connected_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{providerId}, #{externalConnectionKey}, #{connectionStatus}, #{connectedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE connection_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(connection_id), external_connection_key = VALUES(external_connection_key), connection_status = VALUES(connection_status), connected_at = VALUES(connected_at), disconnected_at = NULL, updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
